title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 26.1-04 - Prohibited Practices in Insurance Business
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 26.1 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t26-1.html): title 'Title 26.1 - Insurance', chapter row '26.1-04' with name 'Prohibited Practices in Insurance Business', no '[Repealed]' marker; then fetched https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t26-1c04.html, which lists sections from 26.1-04-01. Currency: 07/01/25 update, 69th Legislative Assembly.
notes: This is North Dakota's unfair trade practices chapter and carries the unfair claim settlement practices standards. The policyholder-side duties on proof and notice of loss sit in ch. 26.1-32 (Loss and Notice of Loss), with the contract rules in ch. 26.1-29 (Insurance Contracts) and ch. 26.1-30 (Insurance Policies); all verified in force on the same index but not listed separately.
